hero.title: Intelligent Governance for Organizations that Transform Lives.
hero.lead: The first Executive Governance Platform™ developed to strengthen Boards, Executives, and Leaders of purpose-driven organizations.
hero.sublead: Illumine was not created to manage organizations. It was created to empower the decisions of organizations that transform society.

category.label: A NEW CATEGORY
category.title: A new category of platform for Non-Profit Organizations.
category.desc: While most solutions were developed to execute operational processes, Illumine was created to support Boards, Executives, and Leaders in strategic decision-making.

board.label: THE END OF UNCERTAINTY
board.title: The Board never decides in the dark again.

problem.label: THE GOVERNANCE CHALLENGE
problem.title: Your organization already executes projects. Now it needs to govern better.
problem.desc_p1: Non-Profit Organizations usually have systems for daily operations. The real challenge is answering questions like:
problem.q3: Does the Board have enough information to decide?
problem.q5: Does our governance inspire confidence in funders?
problem.q6: Are we prepared to grow safely?
problem.conclusion: This is exactly where Illumine operates.

offices.label: THE PLATFORM
offices.title: Executive Offices™
offices.lead: The EROA architecture maps executive responsibilities, not operational departments.

board.title: Board Governance Office™
board.desc: Governance to support strategic deliberations of the Board.

governance.title: Governance Office™
governance.desc: Governance based on indicators, risks, compliance, and institutional maturity.

financial.title: Financial Governance Office™
financial.desc: Strategic analyses on financial sustainability, liquidity, revenue concentration, and trends.

mission.title: Mission Governance Office™
mission.desc: Executive tracking of institutional mission evolution through strategic indicators.

risk.title: Institutional Risk Office™
risk.desc: Executive map of financial, regulatory, legal, and reputational risks.

compliance.title: Compliance Governance Office™
compliance.desc: Continuous evaluation of organizational compliance and transparency.

ai.title: Executive AI Advisory™
ai.desc: Artificial Governance specialized in generating analyses, alerts, and recommendations for top management.

scores.label: EVIDENCE-BASED GOVERNANCE
scores.title: Executive Scores™
scores.lead: Exclusive metrics that transform institutional health into actionable governance.

audience.label: EXECUTIVE FOCUS
audience.title: Developed for those who lead organizations.

ai_advisor.label: EXECUTIVE AI ADVISOR™
ai_advisor.title: The governance generated by the platform.
ai_advisor.ex1: Although financial indicators remain stable, the growing revenue concentration among two funders has raised institutional sustainability risk.
ai_advisor.ex2: Governance maturity evolved from intermediate to advanced following the execution of 82% of the Board's deliberations in the last cycle.
ai_advisor.ex3: The Board has three pending strategic deliberations with high impact.
ai_advisor.ex4: The organization shows consistent evolution in institutional impact indicators.

integrations.label: ECOSYSTEM
integrations.title: Intelligent Integrations™
integrations.desc: Illumine connects to the systems your organization already uses. It integrates data from ERPs, financial systems, accounting solutions, accountability platforms, CRMs, and other sources to generate Executive Governance.
integrations.highlight: We do not replace these systems. We amplify the value of the information they produce.

vision.label: OUR VISION
vision.title: Your mission deserves Executive Governance.
vision.desc: Organizations that transform lives deserve to make decisions with the same level of governance used by the world's largest companies. Because social impact starts with better decisions.
